summary: Autozi Internet Technology filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of director Yafu Guo and CFO Jinming Dong, effective April 15, 2026, without disagreement with company operations. Haiyn Si was elected as director and Hui Zhang, the COO, was appointed CFO effective April 16, 2026. The changes are abrupt but non-discretionary as stated. No advisors or terms were disclosed. As a non-US filer, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K for director/officer changes. The event is the management change itself; watch for further board or operational shifts.
